items.name: NCName
specification:
Functional Description: Parses and returns a valid NCName (non-colonized name) from the input stream based on the current token type. The method utilizes a switch-case structure to handle various token types, consuming the appropriate token and invoking a helper method for NCName processing, while also managing error handling for unexpected tokens.

Args:
None

Returns: String - The image of the current token representing a valid NCName or an error if the parsing fails.

Preconditions:
1. The XPathParser instance must be properly initialized with a valid input stream or token manager.
2. The token source must be correctly set up to provide tokens for parsing.
3. The current token (jj_nt) must be valid and represent a token type that can be processed.

Postconditions:
1. If a valid NCName is parsed, it is returned as a string.
2. The state of the parser (current token) is updated based on the consumed token.
3. The method will throw an exception if an invalid token is encountered.

Invariants:
1. The method will always return a string if the parsing is successful.
2. The switch-case structure ensures that only valid token types are processed.
3. The method will throw a ParseException for any unrecognized token type.
4. The token image is guaranteed to be non-null if a valid NCName is returned.

Exception:
ParseException - If an invalid token is encountered that does not match any expected token types.

items.name: convert
specification:
Functional Description: Converts an object of any type to a specified target type, handling various conversions including arrays, collections, primitives, and custom types. The method recursively processes nested structures and utilizes registered converters for complex types, throwing an exception if conversion is not possible.

Args:
object: Object - The object to be converted; can be of any type including null
toType: Class - The target class type to which the object should be converted

Returns: Object - The converted object of the specified target type; may return null or a primitive default for null inputs

Preconditions:
1. The method must be called with a valid object and a non-null target class type
2. The target type must be a valid Java class that can accept the conversion from the provided object type

Postconditions:
1. Returns an object of the specified type or null if the input object is null
2. The original object remains unchanged after conversion
3. If conversion is successful, the returned object is of the expected type

Invariants:
1. Null objects are converted to their primitive defaults if the target type is primitive
2. The method supports conversion between arrays and collections
3. The method handles nested structures by recursively calling itself
4. Conversion is performed using registered converters if available
5. The method is idempotent for valid conversions (same inputs yield the same output)

Exception:
JXPathTypeConversionException - If the conversion cannot be performed due to incompatible types or missing converters

items.name: CoreFunctionName
specification:
Functional Description: Parses the next token in the input stream and returns an integer code corresponding to the recognized function type. It utilizes a switch-case structure to match the token kind against predefined constants and consumes the token if a match is found. If no valid token is recognized, a ParseException is thrown.

Args:
None

Returns: int - An integer code representing the recognized function type based on the token kind

Preconditions:
1. The input stream must be properly initialized and contain valid tokens for parsing.
2. The token_source must be correctly set up to provide tokens to be parsed.
3. jj_nt must point to the next token in the input stream.

Postconditions:
1. The method returns an integer code corresponding to a recognized function type.
2. The state of the token source and the current token will be updated as tokens are consumed.
3. If an unrecognized token is encountered, a ParseException is thrown.

Invariants:
1. The method will always return a valid integer code for recognized function types.
2. The token consumption process is consistent and will always update the token state.
3. The method will not modify any external state outside of the token parsing context.

Exception:
ParseException - If the token kind does not match any predefined function types, indicating an invalid or unexpected token.

items.name: WildcardName
specification:
Functional Description: Parses and constructs a qualified name (QName) based on the input tokens from an XPath expression. It processes the first part of the QName, checks for an optional second part, and utilizes a compiler to create the QName object, handling various token types and ensuring proper parsing through error handling.

Args:
None

Returns: Object - Returns a QName object constructed from the parsed tokens, representing a qualified name in the XPath context.

Preconditions:
1. The method must be called within a valid parsing context where tokens are available.
2. The token_source must be properly initialized to provide the next token.
3. The compiler must be initialized and capable of constructing QName objects.

Postconditions:
1. A QName object is returned if parsing is successful.
2. The state of the parser (tokens and input stream) is updated based on consumed tokens.
3. No changes are made to the input stream or token source beyond what is necessary for parsing.

Invariants:
1. The method will always return a QName object or throw an exception if parsing fails.
2. The method handles both single and double-part QNames, ensuring flexibility in parsing.
3. The method maintains the integrity of the token stream, consuming tokens as needed without skipping.

Exception:
ParseException - Thrown when an unexpected token is encountered during parsing, indicating that the input does not conform to the expected format.
